title: Spring Boot – Application & Web Platform Observability
description: RED metrics, latency percentiles, slowest endpoints, JVM / CPU / memory / database resources, messaging and frontend for Spring Boot services instrumented with the OpenTelemetry Java agent.

list.name: window
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Window used by rate()/increase(). The OTel SDK exports metrics every 60s, so keep it at 2m or more.

list.name: slow_threshold
list.label: Slow trace threshold
list.description: Minimum duration for the "Slow requests (traces)" panel.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Incoming HTTP requests per second (all selected services).

panels.title: Server error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$window])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window]))

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of server request duration.

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of server request duration.

panels.title: Heap usage
panels.description: Used heap / max heap (worst instance).

targets.expr: max(sum by (job, instance) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", jvm_memory_type="heap"}) / sum by (job, instance) (jvm_memory_limit_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", jvm_memory_type="heap"}))

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: Recent CPU utilization of the JVM process (worst instance, 1 = all cores).

panels.title: Running instances
panels.description: Number of JVM instances reporting metrics.

panels.title: Min uptime
panels.description: Uptime of the most recently (re)started instance.

panels.title: Failed requests / s (by endpoint & status)
panels.description: Server requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status, plus requests that failed with an exception before a status was set.

targets.expr: sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$window]))

sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, error_type) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code="", error_type!=""}[$window]))

panels.title: Error ratio per service
panels.description: Share of requests ending in 5xx (server errors) and 4xx (client errors).

targets.expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$window])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window]))

sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$window])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window]))

panels.title: Top failing endpoints (selected time range)
panels.description: Endpoints with the most 4xx/5xx responses over the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code, error_type) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Top exceptions (selected time range)
panels.description: Exceptions that escaped Spring MVC controllers (Micrometer http.server.requests).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (job, method, uri, exception) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", exception!="none", exception!=""}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Server latency p50 / p95 / p99 per service
panels.description: Percentiles computed from the http.server.request.duration histogram. Click an exemplar dot to jump to the trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window])))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: How request durations are distributed over time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window])))

panels.title: Slowest endpoints (selected time range)
panels.description: Per endpoint over the dashboard time range: p95, p99, average, call count and total time spent. Sorted by p95.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) / sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Top 10 slowest endpoints (average)
panels.description: Average duration over the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) / sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 endpoints by total time consumed
panels.description: Sum of all request durations: which endpoints keep the server busiest (calls × duration).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))
sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$window]))

panels.title: In-flight requests & HTTP sessions
panels.description: Requests currently being processed (Micrometer long task timer) and active Tomcat sessions.

panels.title: Outbound calls / s by target
panels.description: HTTP client calls made by the services (RestClient, RestTemplate, WebClient, ...).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, server_address, le) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))

panels.title: Outbound failures / s
panels.description: Client calls answered with 5xx or failing at the network level (timeouts, connection refused, ...).

targets.expr: sum by (job, server_address, http_response_status_code, error_type) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", error_type!=""}[$window]))

panels.title: Heap memory
panels.description: Used and committed heap vs. the configured maximum (-Xmx).

panels.title: Non-heap memory
panels.description: Metaspace, code cache and compressed class space.

panels.title: Heap used after last GC
panels.description: Live data that survived the last collection. A steadily rising line is a memory-leak signal.

panels.title: Time spent in GC
panels.description: Fraction of wall-clock time spent in garbage-collection pauses.

panels.title: Allocation & promotion rate
panels.description: How fast objects are allocated in the young generation and promoted to the old generation.

panels.title: Buffer pools (direct / mapped)
panels.description: Off-heap memory used by NIO buffers.

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: JVM process CPU and whole-system CPU (1 = 100% of all cores).

panels.title: CPU cores used by the JVM
panels.description: CPU seconds consumed per second, i.e. number of busy cores.

panels.title: System load (1m)
panels.description: Load average compared to the number of cores.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Sockets, files, DB connections... Hitting the max breaks the application.

panels.title: Disk usage
panels.description: Disk used where the application runs.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance) (1 - disk_free_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} / disk_total_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Connection pool usage
panels.description: Used / idle connections in the Hikari pool vs. its maximum size.

panels.title: Threads waiting for a connection
panels.description: Pending connection requests. Anything above 0 for long means the pool is too small or queries are too slow.

panels.title: Connection acquire time p95
panels.description: Time spent waiting to get a connection from the pool.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, pool_name, le) (rate(db_client_connections_wait_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))

panels.title: Connection usage time p95 / p99
panels.description: How long a connection is held before being returned to the pool (≈ transaction duration).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, pool_name, le) (rate(db_client_connections_use_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, pool_name, le) (rate(db_client_connections_use_time_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))

panels.title: Repository call latency p95 (Spring Data)
panels.description: Duration of Spring Data repository methods.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, repository, method, le) (rate(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))

panels.title: Slowest repository methods (selected time range)
panels.description: Spring Data repository methods sorted by p95.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, repository, method, le) (increase(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

sum by (job, repository, method) (increase(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / sum by (job, repository, method) (increase(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
sum by (job, repository, method) (increase(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", state!="SUCCESS"}[$__range]))

panels.title: SQL statement latency p95 (from traces)
panels.description: Computed by the Tempo metrics-generator from JDBC client spans.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, span_name, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service=~"$job", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", span_name=~"(?i)(select|insert|update|delete|merge|call|with|begin|commit|rollback).*"}[$window])))

panels.title: Database latency p95 per database (service graph)
panels.description: Round-trip time from each service to each database, from the Tempo service graph.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (client, server, le) (rate(traces_service_graph_request_client_seconds_bucket{client=~"$job", connection_type="database"}[$window])))

panels.title: Messages / s (produced & consumed)
panels.description: Producer and consumer spans, from the Tempo metrics-generator.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, span_name, span_kind, le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service=~"$job", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_(PRODUCER|CONSUMER)"}[$window])))

panels.title: Frontend operations / s
panels.description: Page loads, fetch/XHR calls and user interactions of the frontend selected in "Frontend service" (Tempo span metrics).

panels.title: Frontend operation latency p95
panels.description: Includes network time as seen by the browser.

panels.title: Service-to-service calls / s
panels.description: Edges of the service graph (frontend → backends → dependencies).

panels.title: Log events / s by level
panels.description: Logback events counted by Micrometer.

panels.title: Error logs
panels.description: Log lines containing "error" or "exception" (Loki).

panels.title: Recent error traces
panels.description: Traces with an error span (Tempo). Click a trace ID to open it.

panels.title: Slow requests (traces)
panels.description: Server spans slower than the "Slow trace threshold" variable.
